name: Memo Mini
tagline: Match the pairs. Grow your collection. A relaxing memory game for kids 4+.
description: Memo Mini is a relaxing memory pairs game for kids aged 4 and up - and the adults playing along. Match pictures across 14 colorful worlds (animals, farm, ocean, dinosaurs, instruments, happy numbers and more), discover 175 pictures for the collection, hear every name read aloud and, with the optional Educational Features, learn words in 7 languages. No ads, no timers, no scolding - three difficulty modes from 4 cards to 24.

features.title: 14 colorful worlds
features.description: Animals, farm, ocean, dinosaurs, instruments, happy numbers and more - each with its own painted world and pictures to match.

features.title: 175 pictures to collect
features.description: Every new pair flies into the collection, and after each level you see the cards you have just discovered.

features.title: Learn words in 7 languages
features.description: Optional Educational Features: names on cards, reading and picture-word matching in English, Polish, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese and Italian.

features.title: Read aloud and real sounds
features.description: The name of every matched pair is spoken, and many pictures - farm animals, instruments, sea creatures - make their own sounds.

features.title: Grows with your child
features.description: Easy, Medium and Hard - from 4 cards to 24, gentle automatic hints and up to 3 stars per level.

features.title: Ad-free, kid-safe
features.description: No ads, no tracking, no text input, no timers, no harsh fail states. Purchases sit behind a parental gate.
